description.default: DiskCanvas gives SiYuan an infinite canvas: lay out netdisk (NebulaDisk) files, SiYuan notes and internal assets side by side, connect them with edges, and export a PNG. Note cards show their title and outline, .canvas files embed into notes as read-only previews, and netdisk files can be dragged straight from the netdisk plugin tree onto the canvas. Reuses the netdisk plugin connection, so there is nothing to configure twice.
description.zh_CN: 盘绘给思源加一张无限画布：把网盘（NebulaDisk）文件、思源笔记与内部资源铺在一起，用连线梳理关系，并可一键导出 PNG。笔记卡片默认只显示标题与大纲，.canvas 可作为只读预览块嵌进笔记正文，网盘文件也能从网盘插件文件树直接拖入画布。网盘连接直接复用网盘插件，无需在画布侧重复配置。
